firstNotPrepared: The graphics have not been prepared on this console yet.
firstExplain: On this first start some textures may look black and some objects may appear a moment late: the console prepares each graphics effect the first time it is drawn. It gets better as you play, and what is prepared is kept for the next starts.
prepareNowDetail: Next, choose your Quest Log (or start a new game you do not save): the game then visits every place by itself behind a loading screen (about 30-40 minutes, best docked) and restarts at the title screen, ready. Your saves are not touched.
playNowDetail: The console prepares the most common graphics first behind a loading screen (about 20 minutes; B there to play at once). Prepare graphics stays in the settings menu: hold Minus (-) in the game, Picture tab.
updateExplain: Prepare graphics: the console can now prepare the graphics of the whole game at once, so that places you have not visited yet are not black or late the first time.
prepareNowDetailUpdate: The game visits every place by itself behind a loading screen (about 30-40 minutes, best docked), then restarts at the title screen, ready. Your saves are not touched. What is already prepared on this console goes faster.
laterDetail: This message does not show again. Prepare graphics stays in the settings menu: hold Minus (-) in the game, Picture tab.
filesTitle: SwitchWakerHD: the game's files were not found
filesNeed: SwitchWakerHD needs your own copy of the game in %s/ (the folders code/, content/ and meta/), as tools/switch/make_sd.py lays it out from your dump (INSTALL.md).
filesCopy: Copy the build/sd/ folder made by make_sd.py to the root of the SD card, then start the game again.
cardBody: The game is visiting every place by itself to prepare its graphics, with the sound and rumble off. It restarts at the title screen when it is done. Your saves are not touched.
stopping: Stopping after this place... What is done is kept.
heading: Hold B to stop. What is done is kept, and Prepare graphics continues from here next time.
menuBody: What is prepared so far is kept; Prepare graphics continues from here next time.
battery: The console prepares each graphics effect the first time it is drawn, so new places can look black or show objects late for a few seconds. Prepare graphics does it for the whole game at once: the game visits every place by itself (30-40 minutes, best docked), then restarts at the title screen. Your saves are not touched.
continueButton: The battery is at %u%%: connect the charger or dock the console first.
statusLine: Done on this console. Again is only useful after an update that changed the graphics.
etaPart: Graphics ready: the whole game has been prepared on this console.
ending: Preparing graphics: %zu of %zu (%s)%s. To stop: hold B.
errNoGame: a place did not load; start it again to continue
errCopy: Preparing graphics: done. Close the game and start it again (your saves are as they were).
bgTitle: start a game first (your Quest Log, or a new game you do not save)
bgBody: could not copy the Quest Log files (is the SD card full?)
bgStarting: Prepare graphics: choose your Quest Log (or start a new game you do not save) and it begins by itself.
bgCompiling: First start: the console prepares the graphics of the game once, so that places are not black or late the first time. This takes about 20 minutes, best docked.
